english.note: Use this when the subtlety comes from deliberate restraint or indirect expression, rather than mere faintness.

examples.english: They did not directly say they wanted me to stay, but gave a subtle hint by asking when I was leaving.
examples.traditional: 佢冇直接話想我留低，只係含蓄咁問我幾點走。
